audit_member_text: AGE is declared INTENT(OUT) at L110, but its incoming values are read in the initiation/aging test at L141-L146 and as neighbor history at L175-L214, before every element is necessarily defined by this invocation. The algorithm requires persistent prior age, so the declared interface conflicts with its use and should be assessed as INOUT.

ANGLE is formed in degrees over the ATAN2 endpoint range at L169, but the quadrant tests cover [-180,-90),[-90,0),[0,90),[90,180) at L174-L216 and exclude exactly +180 degrees; that endpoint would receive no neighbor-propagation assignment in this block.
